# netbox_vlan_translation_policy (Resource)

Manages a NetBox VLAN translation policy (`/api/ipam/vlan-translation-policies/`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_vlan_translation_policy" "customer_a" {
  name        = "customer-a"
  description = "Map customer A VLANs onto the provider core"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name.

### Optional

- `comments` (String) Comments. Defaults to an empty string.
- `description` (String) Description. Defaults to an empty string.
- `owner_id` (Number) ID of the Owner (`netbox_owner`).

### Read-Only

- `display` (String) Display.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the object in NetBox.
- `url` (String) Url.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# netbox_vlan_translation_policy is imported by its NetBox object ID (the number in the object's URL).
terraform import netbox_vlan_translation_policy.example 123
```
